title: bammetrics.metrics/1
description: One Picard metrics file as JSON: the StringHeader texts, the metrics class as typed rows, and the histogram as a second table. Written by --format json and by convert; read back by convert and by read_table. Until 1.0.0 the schema changes only by adding members.

tool.description: The Picard class that wrote the file. Absent when it is not known.

sample.description: The sample named with --sample, or its default. Never part of a Picard file. Absent when it is not known.

headers.description: The StringHeader texts in file order: the command line, then the Started on line.

class.description: The Picard metrics class, or null for a file with a histogram only.

histogram.description: The HISTOGRAM section, or null for a file without one.

key_class.description: The Java class of the key column: java.lang.Integer, java.lang.Byte or java.lang.Double.

more_classes.description: The metrics classes after the first, for a file with more than one. Picard writes one, so the member is absent for a Picard file.

columns.description: The column names in file order.

types.description: One type per column, in column order, from the glossary: int, float or string.

rows.description: One object per row with one member per column, in column order. An int is a JSON integer, a float a JSON number with the digits that read back as the same double, a string a JSON string. null is an empty cell, or a float JSON cannot hold when non_finite lists it.

non_finite.description: The cells whose float is NaN or infinite. Each is null in its row; Picard text prints ? for NaN and Infinity, -? for -Infinity.
